sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety candidates; TerraProbe was selected after avoiding recent VIGIL, ShareLock, Verification Horizon, RolloutPipe, Chai, JERP, Progress Advantage, and harness-design repeats.

Main agent read the arXiv abstract, API metadata, 34-page PDF text, HTML full text, oracle stack, corpus design, statistics, taxonomy, MLOE framework, IAM analysis, limitations, and a third-party summary search result.
Article is pure Markdown with 5000+ Chinese characters; no external image embeds; evidence is represented through tables, formulas, pseudocode, and Mermaid-free structured analysis.
